en.title: User and project adoption manual
en.intro: fullstack-toolkit is a reusable project foundation and a working private-project example. English is the default working language; Simplified Chinese is available from the language selector. Each adopted product keeps its own domain, data, credentials and authorization model. This is not a shared login service for all your products.

sections.title: 1. Create an account and sign in
steps: Open the workspace homepage. Under Create account, enter your name, a valid email address and a unique password of 12–128 characters, then choose Create account. Registration signs you in as USER.
For an existing account, choose Sign in, enter the same email/password and submit. A wrong password produces an error message; use the request ID when asking an operator for help.
Your session can last up to seven days. Sign out when finished, especially on a shared device. Sign out revokes the current session on the server; closing a browser tab alone does not.
Email verification and password recovery are not implemented. Do not use an important account password. Ask the product operator about recovery before storing important data.

sections.title: 2. Manage your private projects
steps: Choose + New project. Enter a title (1–120 characters), optional description (up to 2000 characters) and a status, then choose Create project. The card appears in Planned, In progress or Completed.
Choose Edit on a card to change its title, description or status. Choose Save changes, then refresh to verify the saved result. Cancel closes the form without saving.
Search projects filters the loaded titles and descriptions. The application displays the newest 100 projects. Overview counts refer to loaded projects; they are not an unlimited reporting system.
Choose Delete, then confirm the browser dialog. Deletion is permanent in the application; Cancel leaves the project in place. There is no recycle bin.

Projects belong to their creating account. Another account cannot read, edit or delete them, even by entering a known project URL or sending a request directly. No project sharing or organization membership is provided by this example.

sections.title: 3. Work in English or Simplified Chinese
steps: Use the header language selector to choose English or 简体中文. English remains the default for a new visitor, regardless of the browser's preferred language.
The choice is stored in a non-sensitive preference cookie for one year and restored on refresh, including on the manual page. It does not change your account, session, project IDs or access rights.

Interface copy, form labels, status names, notifications, supported API error codes and date presentation change language. Your project names/descriptions and other user-entered content are never automatically translated.
API field names, enum values, error codes, request IDs, logs and source identifiers remain in English. New products can reuse @toolkit/i18n while owning their own message catalogs.

sections.title: 4. Administrator access
steps: New accounts are always USER. There is no public default administrator, role selector during registration or browser action for promoting accounts.
An explicitly provisioned ADMIN sees Members in the sidebar. Open it to inspect the newest 100 members, then choose Back to projects. This screen is a directory, not a user/role editing console.

Operators provision a new administrator through pnpm db:seed with explicit ADMIN_EMAIL and a unique ADMIN_PASSWORD of 16–128 characters in a private operator environment. The command refuses to overwrite an existing account. Remove bootstrap variables afterward and never put credentials in source, CI logs or tickets.
USER cannot access the member directory API. Hiding a menu is only presentation: the actual role check is performed by the API.

sections.title: 5. Start the next project
steps: Use a fresh copy of the template source. Keep the original project's files, database and deployment intact. Install Node 22.14+ and the package.json-pinned pnpm version; copy .env.example to a private .env.

Run node scripts/init-project.mjs my-product, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and pnpm db:migrate, then pnpm dev. The initializer changes the root name/README title and creates .env only if missing; it does not create a remote repository.

For an existing database, follow docs/deployment.md's backup and verified-schema baseline procedure. Never use database reset, copy a production database into a template or invent passwords for legacy users.

Add domain fields through migrations, shared API contracts and server authorization. Reuse the working project workflow as a pattern. If the existing product already has tenant/role rules, preserve those rules; do not substitute this example's simpler owner-only model.

Run format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build, size-check and e2e. Use disposable test databases/accounts. E2E creates data; do not point it at a customer deployment by accident. Refer to docs/reuse.md and docs/i18n.md for extension details.

sections.title: 6. Deploy and operate
steps: Every project needs a unique HTTPS origin, Compose project name, volume, host ports and private environment. Copying another project's credentials or reusing its data volume is not infrastructure reuse.

Set APP_ORIGIN to the exact HTTPS origin and run docker compose --env-file /secure/runtime.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build. On a shared server, first choose unused loopback ports and a separate Compose project name/paths, and configure only the new hostname in the reverse proxy.

This release uses SQLite on one instance. /api/health checks process liveness; /api/ready queries the database. A green health endpoint is not proof that login, permissions or business operations work.

Before migration, stop this project's writer and back up its complete data volume. Test restoration into a separate disposable volume. Keep protected backups off-host with a retention policy. Never run compose down -v on a live deployment.

Keep immutable source/images and a per-release environment file. Roll back code only against a compatible schema; schema recovery requires a verified backup and matching application version. See docs/deployment.md and docs/verification.md. GitHub workflows require a real repository, secrets and Environment policies before they can run.

sections.title: 7. Troubleshooting and limits
steps: API unavailable: check connectivity, the API/ready endpoint, runtime environment and proxy route. Do not disable TLS verification or expose the database to make the indicator green.

401: sign in again. 403: check the current role and allowed Origin/CSRF configuration. 404 for another user's project is deliberate. 409 usually means a duplicate record. 429 means wait before retrying.
When reporting an error, include the page/action, time, request ID and expected result. Do not send passwords, cookies, access tokens, environment files or customer documents.

This version does not provide email recovery, SSO across products, team project sharing, online subscriptions, HA, PostgreSQL multi-replica operation, uptime guarantees or automated off-host backups. The InvoiceFlow pilot validates reuse in an isolated local environment; it does not silently migrate the existing InvoiceFlow production service.

zh-CN.title: 用户操作与项目接入手册
zh-CN.intro: fullstack-toolkit 是可复用的工程底座，并带有可操作的私人项目示例。英语为默认工作语言，可通过语言选择器切换简体中文。接入后的产品各自保留域名、数据、凭据与权限模型；它不是所有产品共用的统一登录服务。

sections.title: 1. 创建账号与登录
steps: 打开工作空间首页，在“创建账号”下填写姓名、有效邮箱和 12–128 个字符的独立密码，然后提交。注册后以普通用户 USER 身份登录。
已有账号请选择“登录”，使用原邮箱和密码。密码错误会显示提示；需要联系操作者时，请保留请求编号。
会话最长有效七天。使用完毕后请退出登录，尤其是在共用设备上。退出会在服务端撤销当前会话；仅关闭浏览器标签页不会撤销会话。
当前没有邮箱验证与找回密码流程。不要复用重要账号的密码；在保存重要数据之前，先与产品操作者确认恢复办法。

sections.title: 2. 管理私人项目
steps: 点击“+ 新建项目”，填写 1–120 个字符的名称、最多 2000 个字符的可选描述及状态，然后点击“创建项目”。卡片会出现在计划中、进行中或已完成栏目。
点击卡片上的“编辑”修改名称、描述或状态，保存后刷新确认数据仍然存在。“取消”只关闭表单，不保存修改。
搜索框对已加载项目的名称和描述进行筛选。页面最多显示最近 100 个项目；概览统计也是这些已加载项目的统计，并非无限量报表。
点击“删除”并在浏览器确认框中确认。应用内没有回收站，删除不可撤销；取消确认则保留项目。
项目归创建账号所有。其他账号即使知道项目 ID，也不能查询、修改或删除。本示例不提供项目共享或组织成员功能。

sections.title: 3. 使用英语或简体中文
steps: 在顶部语言选择器中选择 English 或简体中文。新访客始终默认使用英语，不跟随浏览器语言自动改为中文。
语言选择保存为有效一年的非敏感偏好 Cookie，刷新和进入手册页后仍会恢复。切换语言不改变账号、会话、项目 ID 或访问权限。
界面文案、表单标签、状态名称、通知、已知 API 错误码对应的提示与日期格式会切换语言。项目名称、描述等用户内容不会被自动翻译。
API 字段、枚举值、错误码、请求编号、日志和代码标识符保持英语。新产品可复用 @toolkit/i18n，并维护自己的业务词典。

sections.title: 4. 管理员权限
steps: 新账号一律为 USER。没有公开默认管理员、注册时选择角色或浏览器中提升角色的功能。
经操作者显式配置的 ADMIN 可在侧栏打开“成员”，查看最近 100 位成员，再返回项目。该页面仅为目录，不是修改用户或角色的管理后台。
操作者在私有环境中明确设置 ADMIN_EMAIL 与 16–128 个字符的独立 ADMIN_PASSWORD，再运行 pnpm db:seed 创建新管理员。已有账号不会被覆盖。配置完成后移除引导变量，禁止将凭据写入源码、CI 日志或工单。
普通用户无法访问成员目录 API。隐藏菜单只是展示，真正的角色检查在 API 服务端执行。

sections.title: 5. 开始下一个项目
steps: 从模板源码创建一份新副本，保留原项目文件、数据库与部署。安装 Node 22.14+ 和 package.json 锁定的 pnpm，将 .env.example 复制为私有 .env。
运行 node scripts/init-project.mjs my-product、pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm db:migrate，然后 pnpm dev。初始化器只修改根名称/README 标题并在缺失时创建 .env，不创建远程仓库。
已有数据库必须按 docs/deployment.md 先备份并核实迁移基线。不要 reset 数据库、把生产数据库复制进模板，或为旧用户凭空生成密码。
通过迁移、共享 API 契约和服务端授权添加业务字段。可参考项目示例的完整链路；已有产品的租户/角色规则应保留，不能用示例中更简单的个人归属模型替换。
执行 format:check、lint、typecheck、test、build、size-check 和 e2e。使用可丢弃测试数据库与账号；E2E 会创建数据，禁止误连客户环境。扩展细节见 docs/reuse.md 和 docs/i18n.md。

sections.title: 6. 部署与运维
steps: 每个项目使用独立 HTTPS Origin、Compose 项目名、数据卷、宿主机端口和私有环境。复制其他项目的凭据或复用其数据卷，不属于基础设施复用。
设置 APP_ORIGIN 为精确的 HTTPS Origin，执行 docker compose --env-file /secure/runtime.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build。共用服务器上要先选择未占用的回环端口、独立 Compose 名称与目录，只配置新域名的代理。
本版本使用 SQLite 单实例。/api/health 检查进程存活，/api/ready 查询数据库。健康检查为绿，不代表登录、权限与业务已经验证。
迁移前停掉本项目写入进程并备份完整数据卷，在独立临时卷中验证恢复。重要备份应异地保存并设置保留策略。线上禁止执行 compose down -v。
保留不可变源码/镜像及每个发布版本的环境文件。仅在兼容数据库结构时回滚代码；结构恢复需要已验证备份和对应应用版本。见 docs/deployment.md 与 docs/verification.md。GitHub 工作流还需要真实仓库、Secrets 和 Environment 策略才能运行。

sections.title: 7. 排错与能力边界
steps: API 不可用时检查网络、API/ready、运行环境和代理路由。不要关闭 TLS 校验或公开数据库来消除红色提示。
401：重新登录。403：检查角色以及 Origin/CSRF 配置。其他账号的项目返回 404 是预期行为。409 通常表示记录重复；429 表示请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。
报错时提供页面/操作、时间、请求编号与预期结果。不要发送密码、Cookie、令牌、环境文件或客户文档。
当前不提供找回密码、跨产品 SSO、团队项目共享、在线订阅、多机高可用、PostgreSQL 多副本、可用性保证或自动异地备份。InvoiceFlow 试点在本地隔离环境验证复用，不会悄悄迁移现有 InvoiceFlow 生产服务。
